Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog: Fix Last.fm account linking by opening authorization through the operating-system default browser with a Dalamud fallback. Pending links now include Open Last.fm authorization and Copy connection link actions and remain available across plugin restarts.
